title: A counterexample concerning the coefficient formula for de Branges-Rovnyak norms
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}(b)$ be the de Branges-Rovnyak space associated to a non-extreme point $b$ of the unit ball of $H^\infty$, and let $φ=b/a$, where $a$ is the Pythagorean mate of $b$. In an earlier article, the author showed that, if $φ\in H^2$, then \[ f\in\mathcal{H}(b) \iff \Bigl(f\in H^2 \text{ and }\sum_{m\ge0}\Bigl|\sum_{n\ge0}\overline{\hatφ(n)}\hat{f}(m+n)\Bigr|^2<\infty\Bigr), \] in which case we have \[ \|f\|_{\mathcal{H}(b)}^2=\sum_{m\ge0}|\hat{f}(m)|^2 +\sum_{m\ge0}\Bigl|\sum_{n\ge0}\overline{\hatφ(n)}\hat{f}(m+n)\Bigr|^2. \] It was also shown that there exists a space…
